data.one_liner: A carousel slider widget for displaying online and local images with fan effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fantasy carousel slider widget supporting online and local images, multiple layout types, custom indicators, image click expansion, and auto-play functionality.
use_when: You need a carousel slider specifically for displaying images with unique visual styles.
You want images to be clickable and expand into a detailed view.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose content carousel for arbitrary widgets rather than just images.
You require complex custom child rendering beyond standard image types.
strengths: Supports multiple built-in slider styles and view configurations.
Handles both local and online images (including SVG support).
Provides built-in image expansion and zoom features.
weaknesses: Limited to displaying images rather than arbitrary widgets.
Platform support is restricted to standard Flutter mobile/desktop targets.
data.minimal_example:
FanCarouselImageSlider.sliderType1(
            imagesLink: sampleImages,
            isAssets: false,
            autoPlay: false,
            sliderHeight: 400,
            showIndicator: true,
          )
